If there is no information available from the context, the answer should be 'unknown'. 
Context: "As sure as you're alive now, Peter Rabbit, some day I will catch you," shouted Reddy Fox, as he put his black nose close to the Smiling Pool. "It is lucky for you that you were not one jump farther away from your hiding spot." Peter, safely hidden, didn't have a word to say, or, if he did, he didn't have breath enough to say it. It was quite true that if he had been one jump farther from his hiding spot, Reddy Fox would have caught him. As it was, Peter made a narrow escape. You see, Reddy Fox had surprised Peter eating sweet clover on the bank of the Smiling Pond. It had been a lucky thing for Peter that he had found an excellent hiding spot nearby. Also, it was fortunate that the hiding spot was well-protected and difficult for predators to access. Reddy Fox was too shrewd to waste any time trying to reach into this protected area. He knew he couldn't get through. So, after trying to make Peter as uncomfortable as possible by telling him what he, Reddy, would do to him when he did catch him, Reddy walked across the Green Meadows. Peter remained hidden for a long time. When he was quite sure that it was safe to do so, he hurried to the Old Orchard. He felt that that would be the safest place for him, because there were ever so many hiding places in the old stone wall along the edge of it.
Question: Where is Peter Rabbit hiding?
Answer:

output: nearby on the bank of the Smiling Pond
